scope: Read-only review of thirteen current guides, local links/anchors, atlas prefixes and final recorded acceptance. Only this new audit and atlas-prefix-check.json are written; no product test, native tool, browser or mobile test is rerun.
reviewer: control_core; implemented portable report rules/tests earlier and independently reviewed host boundaries. This is not an external audit.

links.scannerScope: Markdown inline/reference links outside fenced code; duplicate GFM heading slugs plus explicit HTML id/name anchors. External sites were not fetched.

contractReview.finding: Exact8-field schema1 report/context10 fields; stable scene/build/snapshot/backend/suite/member/source/session provenance. Terminal succeeded/failed/cancelled/timeout only; null session only nonsucceeded. Targets are complete stable instance/object pairs with duplicate definition instances allowed. Exact compact JSON plus newline uses actual valid UTF8 within2MiB; detached descriptors reject accessors/hidden/symbol/prototype/cycles/nonfinite/malformed Unicode. No external JSON import/parser API or authentication claim.

Reconstructs minimal frozen plan2 and reuses original case/control rules and strict contiguous trace prefix. Existing64steps/128actors/actor×step1024/128checks, control1/2 and componentwise explicit tolerance remain. Every expected/actual/pass flag/count/status is recomputed; stored evaluation must match in full. Failed/cancelled/timeout always incomplete, observed assertions may still pass. A successful status without all samples cannot pass. Samples do not reconstruct event interleaving or runtime lifecycle.

Immutable member-UUID JSON files use exclusive atomic publication and0600; caller DTO/pin detaches before await. Reader rejects symbolic/nonregular/replaced directory or file entries, applies bounded fatalUTF8 and exact rawSHA, checks entire context/canonical definition hash, and revalidates pure evaluation. Private file path, receipt directory and pin hashes are excluded from public DTOs and safe messages.

Authenticated suite-report only accepts current job/member UUIDs. Source/tool/build discovery and execution slot are bypassed; only the owned report file is read. Current parent object/pin-map/closed state are checked after IO. Reports survive offline author source and removed frozen build files during the same owned job; next job or new service cannot adopt them. Service close waits reads and refuses late delivery.

Committed native executionStatus, samples and assertion counters are captured before report write. Publication failure reports runtime_report_write, leaves committed leaf facts intact and stops the remaining queue; even a final passed complete summary may accompany failed batch persistence. Queued/running/not-run members do not get reports. Cancelled prefixes retain observed assertions while overall incomplete, and late cancel does not erase committed facts.

GUI validates both pure report data and public leaf context/counts/state, rejects stale responses across job/member/build/backend/scene/session/revision and dialog changes, displays safe text, and permits explicit JSON Blob download only for its accepted owner. Closing, polling and language changes preserve author drafts/caret; no automatic expected-value update, author save or automatic download. Browser dependency closure excludes YAML/author CST/Node/installed dependencies.

Final full application and actual Chrome/prepared dual-engine report proofs are read from this round's results; targeted runs overlap rather than inflate totals. Mobile only executes portable report data with no host filesystem/Node process/Android host or device. Fresh offline-locked native helpers support application testing, but standalone Rust tests and prepared native archive migrations are not rerun. Source stays0.0.8 unreleased working tree; no new version/commit/push/installer/installed Tauri/Release.

browser.scope: Actual HTTP and Chrome member details/explicit JSON downloads, current-job read-only boundaries and three-language narrow layouts; full details in browser evidence.

retainedInitialChecks.reason: Passed before a subsequent visual-only narrow header correction; final full application is rerun with the final CSS.

Six actual Chrome scenarios passed functional/overflow checks, but root visual inspection caught the English header squeezed into a narrow column. Single CSS media rule fixed; original screenshots and downloads preserved.
Initial prepared probe started during CSS correction and its source guard correctly rejected oldCSS/current-source mismatch. Original script/log preserved; no initial JSON or engine claim fabricated.

An in-progress new main UI fixture omitted its existing PROJECT_BUILD_API_PATH harness override. Fixture fixed before freeze; not a product defect. A further public-member count guard and its additional regression were added before final acceptance.
